# XD Code Club (SRCEM) — AI Knowledge & LLM Context

> The official coding and software engineering student community of ShriRam College of Engineering & Management (SRCEM), part of ShriRam Group of Colleges, located at National Expressway, AB Road, Banmore (near Gwalior), Madhya Pradesh, India.

## Organization Identity & Overview
- **Name**: XD Code Club
- **Affiliation**: ShriRam College of Engineering & Management (SRCEM), ShriRam Group of Colleges (SRGOC), Banmore (near Gwalior), Madhya Pradesh
- **Motto**: "Coding for creativity, curiosity & community."
- **Headquarters**: Lab 304, Department of Computer Science & Engineering, SRCEM Campus, National Expressway, AB Road, Banmore (near Gwalior), Madhya Pradesh - 476444, India.
- **Mission**: Bridging classroom computer science theory and production software engineering through 24-hour hackathons, open-source project incubators, competitive DSA duels, and peer mentorship.
- **Website**: https://xdcodeclub.netlify.app
- **Official Email**: xdcodeclub@gmail.com
- **Discord**: https://discord.gg/vVh32R6t
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/company/xd-code-club/
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/xdcodeclub/
- **GitHub Organization**: https://github.com/XDCodeClub

## Flagship Student Projects
1. **DevArena**:
   - Description: Real-time multiplayer algorithmic code battleground with sandboxed Docker test runners and Elo ranking.
   - Tech Stack: Next.js, Node.js, Docker, Socket.io, TailwindCSS.
   - Lead: Jeevesh Para & Dev Guild.
2. **SRCEM CampusMate**:
   - Description: College ERP and verified academic resource portal (PYQ vault, smart 75% attendance calculator, campus notices) serving 1,200+ students.
   - Tech Stack: React, Firebase, Express, TailwindCSS, PWA.
   - Lead: Amit Mahor & Team.
3. **CogniScan AI**:
   - Description: Hackathon-winning ATS resume scanner and real-time AI voice interview mock simulator.
   - Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, LangChain, OpenAI.
   - Lead: XD AI Research Guild.
4. **Nucast dStream**:
   - Description: Decentralized public-domain cinema and media streaming protocol on IPFS and Polygon.
   - Tech Stack: Solidity, Polygon, IPFS, Next.js, Ethers.js.
   - Lead: XD Web3 Chapter.
5. **CodeSphere 3D**:
   - Description: Open-source 3D spatial developer portfolio generator with interactive mini-games and shaders.
   - Tech Stack: Three.js, React Three Fiber, Next.js, GLSL.
   - Lead: Tanish Rathore & Core.
6. **PulseTrack IoT**:
   - Description: Contactless BLE campus attendance check-in system with ESP32 microcontrollers and MQTT.
   - Tech Stack: ESP32, C++, Next.js, PostgreSQL, MQTT.
   - Lead: Hardware & Systems Wing.

## Membership & Joining Information
- **Eligibility**: Open to all enrolled engineering students across all years and departments at SRCEM (CSE, IT, Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Management).
- **Fees**: 100% Free. No membership or registration dues are charged.
- **Application Portal**: https://forms.gle/vjS6yrbdoLu89uHA9
- **Prerequisites**: No prior coding experience required; foundational tracks and beginner bootcamps are provided for freshmen.
